exec git init -b main
at 2026-07-20T12:00:00Z
env TZ=UTC
exec card init --prefix attach-
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/init.txt
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: attach-\n    strategy: sequential\n" > .cardamom/config.yaml'
exec card create 'Attachment origin'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create.txt

# A CLI-created attachment remains usable across issue records, dump
# publication, download, and tombstoning in a freshly migrated store.
exec sh attachment-dump-workflow.sh
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/workflow.txt
! stderr .

-- attachment-dump-workflow.sh --
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

add_output=$(card attachment add report.txt --issue attach-1)
attachment_id=$(printf '%s\n' "$add_output" | sed -n '1p')
markdown_link=$(printf '%s\n' "$add_output" | sed -n '2p')
case "$attachment_id" in
  att_[a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7]) ;;
  *) echo "invalid attachment ID: $attachment_id" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
[ "$markdown_link" = "[report.txt](attachment:$attachment_id)" ]

note_output=$(card state set attach-1 "$markdown_link")
[ "$note_output" = 'Set state on attach-1.' ]

dump_output=$(card dump published)
[ "$dump_output" = "published 1 issues to $PWD/published (4 written, 0 unchanged, 0 removed)" ]

attachment_dir="published/attachments/$attachment_id"
printf '%s\n' \
  'format_version: 1' \
  "attachment_id: $attachment_id" \
  'digest: sha256:e8d95d85d63087a2e60b4f189b38a03c10759143f6e01f5363b5ee6ce7ea3841' \
  'size_bytes: 14' \
  'media_type: text/plain; charset=utf-8' \
  'filename: report.txt' \
  >expected-metadata.yaml
cmp expected-metadata.yaml "$attachment_dir/metadata.yaml"
cmp report.txt "$attachment_dir/files/report.txt"
grep -F "[report.txt](../attachments/$attachment_id/files/report.txt)" \
  published/issues/attach-1.md >/dev/null

get_output=$(card attachment get "$attachment_id" downloaded.txt)
[ "$get_output" = 'wrote downloaded.txt (14 bytes)' ]
cmp report.txt downloaded.txt

remove_output=$(card attachment remove "$attachment_id")
[ "$remove_output" = "removed $attachment_id" ]

printf '%s\n' \
  'recorded the emitted Markdown reference' \
  'published deterministic attachment metadata and bytes' \
  'downloaded identical bytes and tombstoned the attachment'

-- report.txt --
bridge report
-- golden/init.txt --
initialized .cardamom
This checkout now excludes Cardamom's local database and attachment blob files. .cardamom/config.yaml remains suitable to commit.
-- golden/create.txt --
attach-1
-- golden/workflow.txt --
recorded the emitted Markdown reference
published deterministic attachment metadata and bytes
downloaded identical bytes and tombstoned the attachment
